designs.details: dark brown timber walls, brown wooden plank roof, timber ridge beam and a small timber lean-to
designs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent top-down building sprite atlas for a Godot hex-grid tactical game.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND PARENT ARCHITECTURE REFERENCE ONLY. Refer specifically to the row labeled Wood 01. Create a new larger design derived from that parent: dark brown timber walls, brown wooden plank roof, timber ridge beam and a small timber lean-to.
Primary request: ONE 2-hex wood building design, shown in six orientations. Design: one elongated continuous rectangular building with an uninterrupted long ridge and a small attached entry porch. This must be one continuous building with connected roofs and walls, not a group of detached single-hex houses. It is substantially longer than the reference parent, with the width of one normal house and length appropriate for 2 adjacent game hexes.
Composition: square transparent sheet with EXACTLY 3 columns and 2 rows, one isolated complete view centered in each of the six equally sized square cells. Reading order top row: 0°, 60°, 120°; bottom row: 180°, 240°, 300°. At 0° the long axis is VERTICAL on the sheet, rotated clockwise in exact 60° increments for subsequent views. All six views are the exact same roof plan, building silhouette, dimensions, details, chimneys and extensions rotated as a rigid object; no redesign between views. Use a consistent common scale. Keep each complete silhouette inside its cell with a generous transparent gap between views. Fill roughly 75 percent of each cell's long dimension.
Style: match the detailed painted, slightly rustic roofs and outlines in the reference; strict orthographic top-down bird's-eye game sprite with visible roof and only narrow wall/eave edges, never isometric or frontal. All roof surfaces brown, warm natural timber and brown shingles/planks.
Transparent background. No scenery, no floor, no ground, no vegetation, no characters, no labels, no text, no hex grid, no coloured glow or outline fringe. Only the six building views. Do not include any of the other reference building types.
